text: dsh-web-search-exa 是面向 DSH web seam 的 Exa 网页搜索 provider 插件。它向 DSH 注册 exa 搜索提供方，并通过 bundle 将 web_search 路由到该提供方，同时保留 http 网页抓取配置。搜索时插件把查询和可选结果数量发送到 Exa /search API，再将返回的 URL、标题、摘要片段和发布日期整理为来源。可配置搜索类型、高亮长度与超时。适合希望用 Exa 为 DSH 网页搜索提供结果的用户；需要 Exa API 密钥，可从凭据、密钥文件或 EXA_API_KEY 环境变量读取。

dsh-web-search-exa connects DSH web_search to Exa. It registers the exa provider, sends queries to Exa’s /search API, and maps links, titles, and snippets into sources. An Exa API key is required; credentials, a key file, or EXA_API_KEY can supply it.
想让 DSH 的网页搜索改用 Exa 返回结果。
Can I route DSH web_search queries through Exa?
dsh-web-search-exa 的功能「Exa 网页搜索」：为 DSH web seam 注册 exa provider。调用 web_search 时，它向 Exa 搜索并把链接、标题和摘要整理成来源。
dsh-web-search-exa 需要 Exa API 密钥；默认从 EXA_API_KEY 环境变量读取，也可配置凭据或密钥文件。（见 lib/index.js:23-28,172-186）
dsh-web-search-exa 会将搜索查询发送到 Exa 的 api.exa.ai /search API，并在请求头中提供 API 密钥。（见 lib/index.js:88-93）

dsh-web-search-exa README · dsh-web-search-exa：An [Exa](https://exa.ai) search provider for DeepSeek Harness. It registers the provider `exa`
on the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` seam, so the `web_search` tool sends its queries to Exa's
`/search` API and returns the results as sources. It works the same from dsh web, dsh-TUI and
headless runs. `web_fetch` is unchanged. The plugin has no UI of its own.

dsh-web-search-exa README · Install：The package is a dsh bundle. Use the profile you run (`web`, `headless`, …):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jakehemmerle/dsh-web-search-exa#v0.3.0-rc.1
export EXA_API_KEY=…   # in the environment that launches dsh
```

The bundle's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) pins the web seam's `searchProvider` to
`exa` and adds the `web-search-exa` row. Restart dsh web after installing.

dsh-web-search-exa README · Install：This release is qualified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; its peer pin is exact, so other DSH
versions need `dsh plugin allow-version` or a newer release.

dsh-web-search-exa README · Configuration：Override the row in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the whole row
config, so restate any field you keep.

dsh-web-search-exa README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `EXA_API_KEY` | Key name: looked up in dsh's credential store, then (after `apiKeyFile`) in the environment |
| `apiKeyFile` | (unset) | File holding the key (raw or dotenv), read on every search, so a rotated key needs no restart; it wins over the environment |
| `apiKey` | (unset) | Literal key, used before any other source (avoid) |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.exa.ai` | Exa API origin |
| `type` | `auto` | Exa search type |
| `highlightChars` | `600` | Highlight length per result |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Request timeout |

dsh-web-search-exa README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: web-search-exa
  config:
    apiKeyFile: /run/secrets/exa
```

dsh-web-search-exa README · Development：`nix flake check` runs the fast suites against the pinned dsh; `nix run .#e2e` runs the real
dsh web (Playwright), dsh-TUI (private tmux) and headless suites against a local mock Exa.
